metric_separation_note: Four independent counters. None may be redefined or substituted mid-task. The previous atom-to-product-level unsound-counter redefinition (boundary task) is documented in ../rc3-1-support-boundary/train-comparison.json and remains historical.

ATOM_RELATION_ACCURACY.definition: exact correct semantic relation / all expected claim atoms (single-atom cases count one atom; compound cases count each expected atom separately)

PRODUCT_AGGREGATION_ACCURACY.definition: top-level aggregated compound verdict == expected rel / all compound cases (diagnostic; not a section 34 gate)

SUPPORT_BOUNDARY_PRECISION.definition: eligible proofs on COMPATIBLE cases / all eligible proofs on the frozen 80-case boundary suite

PROOF_ELIGIBILITY_ACCURACY.definition: atoms where (relation==ENTAILS AND boundary==BOUNDARY_COMPATIBLE) matches the expected auto-support-eligibility label / all labeled atoms

MACRO_F1.definition: unweighted mean of per-class F1 over ENTAILS, CONTRADICTS, PARTIAL, RELATED_BUT_INSUFFICIENT, AMBIGUOUS on the fresh relation suite

ENTAILS_PRECISION.definition: correct ENTAILS predictions / all ENTAILS predictions (fresh suite)

CONTRADICTS_PRECISION.definition: correct CONTRADICTS predictions / all CONTRADICTS predictions (fresh suite)

CRITICAL_FALSE_ENTAILS.definition: ENTAILS predictions on critical-flagged cases whose expected relation is not ENTAILS

CRITICAL_FALSE_CONTRADICTS.definition: CONTRADICTS predictions on critical-flagged cases whose expected relation is not CONTRADICTS

INSUFFICIENT_RECALL.definition: correct RELATED_BUT_INSUFFICIENT predictions / all expected RELATED_BUT_INSUFFICIENT atoms
